answer: Escrowed earnings ledge: every new agent's rewards land on a ledge account that unlocks only after 90 days of clean behaviour, released in small daily trickles. If an agent is proven a sybil, its ledge and the ledges of agents it paid are clawed back. An attacker running 500 ivory-tower clones must float months of unpaid labour per key and can lose it all to one zephyr of evidence, so farming has negative expected value.
